metadata.title: JX General Dynamics 0.6.0rc8
metadata.description:
JX General Dynamics 0.6.0rc8 is a reproducible release candidate of the JX celestial-dynamics engine. This archive contains the exact Python source distribution, CPython 3.14 Linux x86-64 wheel, release manifest, artifact manifest, CUDA release-gate record, accuracy-matched JX/REBOUND screening benchmark, and SHA-256 inventory published with the GitHub prerelease.

Scientific status: SCREENING_ONLY. Model output is not astronomical evidence, and this record does not establish production fitness, a Planet X detection, or broad superiority over REBOUND.
